reviews.x: Not with rose scent, smell synthetic fruity but not unpleasant. Some dirt outside one of the boxes (see photo), I thought it is made by in USA but not. One sheet is enough for rubbing and washing hands, remember to take it out with dry hands; no ideas on its ingredients but a bit drying my hands.
I like the convenience of having soap in my purse for rest stops that are low on soap. I can still get clean hands. Smells great too.
Work great, smell good, handy for everyday use

I like the fact that I can take it everywhere. Some establishments don't check the bathrooms for stuff like soap, toilet tissue, and paper towles as they should. It just makes it easier on me knowing that I can wash my hands with soap always.
I found nothing to dislike about this product. It serves its purpose, for those facilities that hand soap is not present. Great rose scent.

Only reason for the 4 straws is because it doesn’t have scent like the description says. It doesn’t have any scent at all. But otherwise great idea. It doesn’t bubble like normal soap does but you do get a decent amount for a quick wash.

reviews.t: I kept some and gave some as gifts.
reviews.x: Ordered twice and gave away to girlfriends and my sister. Now, my 3rd order will be mainly for the convenience of my daughter and myself to be able to carry in our purses. However, after trying one, I do feel that they could be just a little more sudsy.

reviews.t: Great for on the Travel but no scent!
reviews.x: My wife and I bought these for our trip to India as we were going to be traveling quite a bit.  This was very convenient as some bathrooms did not have soap.  Overall I am pleased with the soap as it did clean my hands.  Just note that you should take out a strip before you wet your hands so you don't ruin the rest of the strips.  The strips are almost paper thin and they dissolve immediately after contacting with water.  The reason for 4 star rating is because it does not leave any smell as the

All individually wrapped, All smell fabulous,  Luv that there Pink, All have there very own plastic container, No filmy residue, My skin is sensitive so I only use the Best Just the right amount of soap need to wash ur hands In-The-Go, Let's be honest there are times you use a bathroom obviously not at home and those places doctor's office, fast food restaurants, supermarkets

reviews.t: Thin piece of paper but lathers up well :)
reviews.x: Perfect for travel use and fun as well for kids :) My husband made the video when she had our daughter use it, lol

Reminds me of my great grandma  She loved rose scents.  It is not strong but it lasts long.  I love the smell personally.  Though I can see how some people wouldn’t.  Worked great.  The container they are in can use some help.  Going to use a rubber and to keep closed opens too easily.  Will order again when all used up. These day the less I have to touch that isn’t mine the better  Def recommend this prod  4 stars because of the container.

Trust me, if you buy this product you will definitely NOT be disappointed. The papers are the right size. The soap is NOT sticky or feel glue like, plenty of soap and lather’s beautifully to wash your hands even more than 20 seconds. My hands felt clean with a very light smell but the smell is very pleasant. The plastic case that the papers are in is a perfect size for a small handbag or even a small pocket for traveling.

I tried one and it wirked as expected. Enough lather for my hands. I shared some with other friends and family to put in their purses or cars. Too often places with restrooms haven't any hand soap. My problem is solved. Nice size for easy carry. Not crazy over pink color. Rather have white, gray, black. But then again, I didn't buy them to match my outfits. They work well.

reviews.t: Travel soap sheets work better than expected.expectedxpected.t
reviews.x: Worked WAY better than I expected.  Alot of soap is tissue thin sheet.  Alot of sheets per travel case, and x travel cases per pack.  The only suggestion would to make a better clasp on each case.  I had to put a rubber band on the travel case to keep it from opening in my purse, other wise great.

Excellent idea and good product with a light scent.  However the container in which the soap is in is very low quality and keeps opening and soap ends up in the bottom of my bag and items covered in soap.  I would by this again if the container would stay shut.

These are fabulous. Primarily, I bought these for hiking but also great traveling/on the go in the car.  (I would rather wash my hands over sanitizer any day)  If you don't like a rose scent, you wouldn't enjoy the smell but I actually really like it.

reviews.t: It works fine, but didn’t like the fragrance at all.
reviews.x: I like the concept.  Very convenient.  But the scent is not appealing!! Who wants to have their hands smelling like old lady powder?  Seriously, come out with something more appealing, strawberry, coconut, vanilla, cherry  or lemon scented Please!!

These are so light weight yet one little sheet will amount to about 2 pumps of soap! It’s perfect. Take out the soap sheet first with dry hands and then wash hands so you don’t get the others wet! Works amazing for traveling/road trips/hiking etc.

I got similar ones in a gift pack that were great.  These are not as good but hey when a bathroom is out of soap they are a lifesaver.  These are somewhat gritty and need a lot of water to dissolve.  Great for an emergency.

Not too impressed with them they kind of leave a thick residue on your hands. I understand that you have to add water to them but it’s still leaves your hands feeling like there’s stuff on them and not a clean feeling

I definitely recommend these specially right now that we are dealing with Covid-19.  I keep one in every purse and in my car. Along with a bottle of water and I wash my hands after leaving everyplace I go to
Fits in all my purses or even my pocket if I'm not carrying a purse around that day. Super convenient for traveling especially in Asian countries where they don't always have soap in the bathrooms.
This little soap sheets are great for traveling or the outdoors, I got them along with the towelettes and I loved them, do not use too much water, and the suds were way more that I expected
Has a nice smell makes my hand feel soft Sheets of soap maybe a little smaller seem like a lot of soap to try to rinse off while traveling but I love it and if I need more I will buy again

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the product's convenience for travel and on-the-go use, especially when restrooms lack soap.
Many reviewers report the soap lathers well and cleans hands effectively, though some find it less sudsy than regular soap.
Opinions on scent are mixed: some love the rose scent, while others report little to no scent or a synthetic fruity smell.
Several reviewers criticize the plastic containers, noting they open too easily and involve excessive packaging.
A few reviewers mention the soap can be drying or that hands should be dry when removing a sheet.
